correction: Deciding "the artifact this build produced" by file name alone breaks on a rebuild that produces the same name: the same commit on the same day yields a byte-identical file with an identical name, so a name-based diff reports zero new files and the run stops on a complete build. Treat a file as this build's output when it did not exist before the build or its mtime is not older than the build start, and require exactly one such file.
